notes.title: Graphics Update
notes.notes:
You can update now, and if you cannot access automatic updates, please verify the files.

What has changed?


 The game's infrastructure has been updated and improved.

 A new map has been added.

 The quest system has been revamped.

 Mounts have been removed from the game.

 All of the main character's graphics have been updated.

 The tutorial section has been improved and made more helpful.

 All reported bugs have been fixed.


Additional Notes:

Please make sure you have the latest version of the game installed to benefit from these updates.
If you encounter any issues after the update, please restart the game or contact the developers for assistance.
We hope you enjoy these latest updates and continue to have fun playing our game!

Please let me know if you have any other questions.

notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
Hello!
*Voice errors have been fixed.

*Farming System Changed (Changed from a dialogue-style system to an interaction-style system, meaning you no longer need to answer empty questions to plant a seed.)
-You can now water your crops and they will grow on a daily basis.
-The crop area has been restricted, increasing the importance of the greenhouse.
-You can plant any crop you want in farming areas. (This means you can plant any crop you want in one region.)
-Some crops have been changed and the images of all crops have been updated.

*Fish System Changed & Improved.
-Instead of waiting empty-handed, you can now catch fish with a mini-game.
-Not all regions will have the same fish. There are a total of 5 different regions.
-Fishing rods will help you catch fish faster.

*Animal System
-When you feed an animal, you won't have to wait. Depending on the percentage, it will give you a product when you feed it, so you can feed it as many times as you want during the day.
-Mining and Other Systems have been Changed.
-When you dig with tools, you will immediately take action without waiting and you will be able to do professions such as mining faster.

*Menu
-Menu background changed.

Additionally, a few things have been changed/removed:
*The mines in the cave have been replaced.
*Tutorial texts have been updated to fit the new systems.
*Starter chest items have been refreshed.
*Now, you can call mounts and pets using the flute item instead of the menu.
*Quest icons have been changed.
*All icons in the game have been replaced.
*Flute items have been added to NPCs for 500G.

**The update is now live, and I didn't have much time to test the new systems, so please let me know of any errors, no matter how small.
Also, I believe this update may cause issues with old save files. I hope you understand.
***Update Size: 10.9 MB

I hope this update will be pleasing to you. Have a good day!
